item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 06/Sep/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry continental airstream will continue to bring generally fine and very hot weather to southern China today. An easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of southern China midweek this week. Meanwhile, a broad trough of low pressure will bring showers to the coast of Guangdong and the northern part of the South China Sea. With the broad trough of low pressure departing, showers will ease off over the coastal areas in the latter part of this week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Hinnamnor will move towards the vicinity of the Korean Peninsula and the Sea of Japan today, and evolve into an extratropical cyclone gradually.
